original_source: Fresh IID even-native qutrits with two independent uniform full-ring frequency rows and shared secret; uniform ALL secrets, not primitive-only.
narrowed_target: Polynomial-cost first-coordinate least-trit learner with inverse-polynomial advantage over1/3 at every required lower root.
implemented_components: Exact public known-prefix phase correction into the lower native ring source
Uniform-secret random self-reduction with scalar sign symmetrization
Conditional full-recovery amplification and fresh-copy cost ledger
Original-record ancestry checks and empirical plurality without probability certification
Information-only arbitrary FULL-label collective receiver copy bound
Exponential least-trit optimum with matching primal/dual derivation
Actual polynomial final-field decoder given an external correct high-depth prefix

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of the exact source bridge, randomization independence, weak-error amplification, copy gate and reference optimum.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-WEAK-LEARNER: Construct and prove a native full-label higher-root least-trit learner; no truthful oracle or all-secret enumeration.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-ALL-SECRETS: Guarantee uniform-all-secret advantage at every lower root, including zero and nonprimitive inputs.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SOURCE: Fresh original IID states for each call; correct prefixes are conditional on no earlier error. No post-measurement field type cast.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COST: Polynomial inverse advantage, fresh-state count, runtime, source acquisition and aggregate root-phase precision.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-FIBER-COMPILER: No free conditional nuisance-fiber preparation, erasure, whitening or unknown inverse.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-ESTIMATOR: Give a polynomial computable outcome-to-trit estimator, not a dense information-only reference.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-BASELINES: Challenge the weak learner with joint classical raw-sample inference and known complete sieve baselines.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Prove efficient native source acquisition from a natural algorithmic problem before any major speedup claim.

falsifiers: Native physical corrected amplitudes disagree with the promised lower-root state.
Randomized weak-learner view depends on the hidden shift/sign metadata.
Wrong-class bias is amplified without sign symmetrization.
Repeated calls reuse original ancestors or chosen frequencies.
An incorrect prefix is silently assigned a valid lower source.
An inverse-polynomial weak advantage violates the native mean-copy bound.
The externally given prefix or exponential fiber reference is presented as full native secret discovery.
